explanation: Expresses a standpoint -- 'for ~ / from the perspective of ~'.
example_sentence: 子供にとって、遊びはとても大切だ。(For children, play is very important.)
drill_sentence: この決断は会社___とって重要だ。(に)

explanation: Expresses that something is based on a certain thing -- 'based on ~'.
example_sentence: この映画は実話に基づいて作られた。(This movie was made based on a true story.)
drill_sentence: データ___基づいて、計画を立てた。(に)

explanation: Indicates the issue that a dispute or discussion centers on -- 'surrounding ~ / over the issue of ~'.
example_sentence: 遺産をめぐって、兄弟が争っている。(The siblings are fighting over the inheritance.)
drill_sentence: その土地___めぐって、裁判が続いている。(を)

explanation: Expresses a means or a period through which something happens -- 'through ~ / throughout ~'.
example_sentence: 友人を通じて、彼女を紹介してもらった。(I was introduced to her through a friend.)
drill_sentence: 一年___通して、暖かい地域です。(を)

explanation: Expresses that one change accompanies another -- 'along with ~ / as ~ happens'.
example_sentence: 人口の増加に伴って、住宅問題が深刻化した。(As the population increased, housing problems worsened.)
drill_sentence: 技術の発展___伴って、生活が便利になった。(に)

explanation: Expresses that something changes according to a condition -- 'according to ~ / in response to ~'.
example_sentence: 収入に応じて、税金の額が変わる。(The amount of tax changes according to income.)
drill_sentence: 能力___応じて、仕事を割り当てる。(に)

explanation: Expresses following along a line, plan, or policy -- 'along ~ / in accordance with ~'.
example_sentence: 計画に沿って、工事を進めています。(We are proceeding with the construction in accordance with the plan.)
drill_sentence: 川___沿って、桜の木が並んでいる。(に)

explanation: Expresses an area someone particularly excels in -- 'when it comes to ~'.
example_sentence: 料理にかけては、彼女は誰にも負けない。(When it comes to cooking, she doesn't lose to anyone.)
drill_sentence: スピード___かけては、彼が一番だ。(に)

explanation: Expresses that something doesn't match expectations based on a given fact -- 'for ~ / considering ~'.
example_sentence: 初心者にしては、上手に弾けている。(For a beginner, they're playing quite well.)
drill_sentence: 冬___しては、今日は暖かい。(に)

explanation: Expresses concession -- 'even granting that ~ / even if ~'.
example_sentence: 忙しいにしても、返事ぐらいはできるはずだ。(Even if you're busy, you should at least be able to reply.)
drill_sentence: 行けない___にしても、連絡はしてください。(に)

explanation: Expresses that something exceeds a comparison point even more -- 'even more than ~'.
example_sentence: 今年は去年にもまして、暑い夏になった。(This year became an even hotter summer than last year.)
drill_sentence: 健康は何___にもまして大切だ。(より)

explanation: Expresses 'not to mention ~, needless to say ~'.
example_sentence: 日本語はもとより、英語も話せる。(Not to mention Japanese, they can speak English too.)
drill_sentence: 平日___もとより、休日も働いている。(は)

explanation: Emphasizes the true reason for something -- 'precisely because ~'.
example_sentence: 君のことを思えばこそ、厳しく言うのだ。(It's precisely because I care about you that I speak harshly.)
drill_sentence: 愛が___こそ、別れを選んだ。(あれば)

explanation: Expresses strong condemnation -- 'should not, unforgivable to ~' (formal, follows a role noun).
example_sentence: それは医者にあるまじき行為だ。(That is an act unbecoming of a doctor.)
drill_sentence: 教師に___まじき言葉だ。(ある)

explanation: A formal, written prohibition -- 'must not ~'.
example_sentence: 芝生に入るべからず。(Do not enter the lawn.)
drill_sentence: ここに駐車す___からず。(べ)

explanation: Expresses a strong, continuing feeling -- 'cannot help but ~ / deeply ~' (formal, with feeling verbs).
example_sentence: 皆様のご健康を願ってやみません。(I sincerely wish for everyone's good health.)
drill_sentence: 彼の成功を期待し___。(てやまない)

explanation: A formal way to say 'without ~'.
example_sentence: 努力なくして、成功はない。(Without effort, there is no success.)
drill_sentence: 信頼___なくしては、良い関係は築けない。(が)

explanation: Expresses 'even if not to that extent, at least ~'.
example_sentence: 毎日とは言わないまでも、週に一度は運動すべきだ。(I won't say every day, but you should exercise at least once a week.)
drill_sentence: 完璧で___までも、まあまあの出来だ。(ない)

explanation: Expresses that something is on the verge of happening -- 'as if about to ~'.
example_sentence: 今にも泣かんばかりに、彼女は訴えた。(She pleaded as if she were about to cry.)
drill_sentence: 爆発せ___ばかりに、彼は怒った。(ん)

explanation: Expresses an uncontrollable urge -- 'can't help but ~'.
example_sentence: この曲を聞くと、泣かずにはいられない。(When I hear this song, I can't help but cry.)
drill_sentence: 面白すぎて、笑わ___にはいられない。(ず)

explanation: Expresses being forced into a situation by circumstances -- 'be forced to ~'.
example_sentence: 台風のため、試合の中止を余儀なくされた。(Due to the typhoon, the match was forced to be canceled.)
drill_sentence: 資金不足で、計画の変更___余儀なくされた。(を)

explanation: Expresses an extreme degree -- 'extremely ~' (formal, with na-adjectives).
example_sentence: 彼の態度は失礼極まりない。(His attitude is extremely rude.)
drill_sentence: この状況は危険___。(極まりない)

explanation: Expresses doing one thing while taking the opportunity to do another -- 'while ~ / on the occasion of ~'.
example_sentence: 散歩がてら、コンビニに寄った。(I stopped by the convenience store while taking a walk.)
drill_sentence: 買い物___、友達に会った。(がてら)

explanation: Expresses doing something alongside a main activity -- 'while also ~'.
example_sentence: 彼は会社員のかたわら、小説を書いている。(He writes novels alongside being a company employee.)
drill_sentence: 主婦の___、パートで働いている。(かたわら)

explanation: Expresses that something happens repeatedly right after another action -- 'as soon as ~ / no sooner than ~'.
example_sentence: 片付けるそばから、子供が散らかす。(As soon as I tidy up, my child makes a mess again.)
drill_sentence: 覚える___から、忘れてしまう。(そば)

explanation: Expresses that something happens immediately after another action -- 'as soon as ~'.
example_sentence: ベルが鳴るや否や、生徒たちは教室を飛び出した。(As soon as the bell rang, the students dashed out of the classroom.)
drill_sentence: 彼を見る___否や、彼女は逃げ出した。(や)

explanation: Expresses that one action follows another almost instantly -- 'no sooner ~ than ~'.
example_sentence: 彼は席に着くが早いか、居眠りを始めた。(No sooner had he sat down than he began to doze off.)
drill_sentence: スタートの合図が鳴る___早いか、選手たちは走り出した。(が)

explanation: Expresses regret or criticism -- 'if only ~, but ~ / though'.
example_sentence: 早く言ってくれればよかったものを。(If only you had told me sooner...)
drill_sentence: 謝れば済む___を、彼は意地を張った。(ものを)

explanation: Expresses acting in light of one's position or a prior statement -- 'given that ~ / in light of ~'.
example_sentence: 約束した手前、行かないわけにはいかない。(Given that I promised, I can't not go.)
drill_sentence: 先輩という___、後輩の前で弱音は吐けない。(手前)

explanation: Expresses disregarding something -- 'ignoring ~ / in disregard of ~'.
example_sentence: 周囲の心配をよそに、彼は無謀な計画を進めた。(Ignoring everyone's worries, he pushed ahead with the reckless plan.)
drill_sentence: 反対の声___よそに、開発は進められた。(を)
